thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 21 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters viewed the episode as an important development for the central relationship and appreciated a character’s selfless intervention.
The romance generated interest, but some commenters were frustrated by the leads’ continued hesitation and uncertainty about what keeps them apart.
Commenters criticized the adviser character as ineffective and felt that omitted background material weakened the handling of another character.
The episode’s dramatic conventions were treated humorously by some, while others found the older shoujo-style material excessive or troubling.
